final inspection after all rebar positioned in formwork; hold point for concrete pour clearance Download ExcelDownload PDF **26** Checkpoints **6** Sections Once per element pour QA/QC Engineer, Site Engineer [IS 456:2000](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456-2000) [IS 1786:2008](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1786-2008) [IS 13920:2016](https://infralens.in/code/IS-13920-2016) Related [📐IS 456](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456) [✏️Minimum Ceiling Height Resi…](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/minimum-ceiling-height-residential) [📘Column Load Capacity Tables](https://infralens.in/handbook/column-capacity) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. PRE-PLACEMENT VERIFICATION | | A1 | Formwork inspection completed and approved
Acceptance: Formwork approval record available; no defects (cracks, gaps >5mm, instability); struts and bracing secure; inspection date within 7 days of concrete pour | IS 456:2000 Cl. 14 — Formwork | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Cover blocks placed — spacer type and spacing verified
Acceptance: Cover blocks (plastic/precast) used; type matches specification; spacing ~1m c/c both directions; blocks securely tied to bars; height = design cover | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.4 — Concrete cover to reinforcement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Correct bar marks selected per drawing
Acceptance: Each bar bundle checked against drawing; correct mark (e.g., B1, B2, C1) placed in correct location; BBS matched; date of fabrication verified | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26 — Reinforcement detailing | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Bars clean — free from loose rust, oil, mud, concrete
Acceptance: Bars free of loose rust, oil, dirt, or hardened concrete; light mill scale acceptable; clean with wire brush if necessary; moisture film acceptable (not standing water) | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.1 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. BOTTOM REINFORCEMENT — MAIN & DISTRIBUTION BARS | | B1 | Main bars — correct diameter per drawing
Acceptance: Verify 5 random bars: diameter matches drawing; use vernier calipers; tolerance per IS 1786 Table 3; document actual diameter | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.2 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Main bars — correct number per drawing
Acceptance: Count actual bars in section; compare to drawing; no missing or extra bars; count tolerates ±0 (exact match required) | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.2 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Main bars — correct spacing per drawing
Acceptance: Measure spacing between adjacent bars: minimum clear spacing = max of (bar diameter, 1.5× max aggregate size, 75mm); document min/max spacing; tolerance ±50mm | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.3.3 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Distribution bars placed correctly
Acceptance: Distribution bars perpendicular to main bars; spacing ≤max of (main bar spacing/5, 300mm, 0.3× lesser span); correct diameter per drawing | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.3.2 — Distribution bars | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B5 | Cover verified — bottom cover per IS 456 Cl. 26.4.2
Acceptance: Measure cover with cover meter or cover gauge at 5 locations; cover ≥specified minimum per exposure class (e.g., 30mm for M30 moderate); tolerance -5/+10mm | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.4.2 — Minimum cover | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. TOP REINFORCEMENT | | C1 | Negative moment bars in correct position
Acceptance: Negative bars extend per drawing; typically extend from 0.2L each side of support; anchored with hooks/laps; spacing and diameter correct | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.5.2 — Top bars (cantilever/continuous spans) | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Cranking bars at correct location
Acceptance: Cranking location matches drawing ±100mm; cranked bars inclined ~45° per drawing; anchor beyond bend per Cl. 26.2.5.1 | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.3.2 — Bent-up bars | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Chair bars/spacers support top bar mat
Acceptance: Chair bars or plastic spacers placed at ~1m grid spacing; height = design cover over top bars; chairs securely tied; no settling of top bars evident | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26 — Bar support practice | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Cover to top bars verified per drawing
Acceptance: Measure cover at 5 locations; cover ≥specified minimum (e.g., 30mm for M30 slab, 40mm for M30 beam bottom); use cover meter; tolerance -5/+10mm | IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.4.2 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | Showing 13 of 26 checkpoints ·View all → A. PRE-PLACEMENT VERIFICATION A1Formwork inspection completed and approved IS 456:2000 Cl. 14 — Formwork (Formwork must be safe, stable, and adequate to support construction loads) ✓ Formwork approval record available; no defects (cracks, gaps >5mm, instability); struts and bracing secure; inspection date within 7 days of concrete pour OKNCNAHOLD A2Cover blocks placed — spacer type and spacing verified IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.4 — Concrete cover to reinforcement (Cover blocks maintain specified concrete cover; standard spacing 1m c/c) ✓ Cover blocks (plastic/precast) used; type matches specification; spacing ~1m c/c both directions; blocks securely tied to bars; height = design cover OKNCNAHOLD A3Correct bar marks selected per drawing IS 456:2000 Cl. 26 — Reinforcement detailing (Bar identification critical for proper placement) ✓ Each bar bundle checked against drawing; correct mark (e.g., B1, B2, C1) placed in correct location; BBS matched; date of fabrication verified OKNCNAHOLD A4Bars clean — free from loose rust, oil, mud, concrete IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.1 (Clean bar surface essential for bond with concrete) ✓ Bars free of loose rust, oil, dirt, or hardened concrete; light mill scale acceptable; clean with wire brush if necessary; moisture film acceptable (not standing water) OKNCNAHOLD B. BOTTOM REINFORCEMENT — MAIN & DISTRIBUTION BARS B1Main bars — correct diameter per drawing IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.2 (Bar size critical for structural design) ✓ Verify 5 random bars: diameter matches drawing; use vernier calipers; tolerance per IS 1786 Table 3; document actual diameter OKNCNAHOLD B2Main bars — correct number per drawing IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.2 (Number of bars as per structural design) ✓ Count actual bars in section; compare to drawing; no missing or extra bars; count tolerates ±0 (exact match required) OKNCNAHOLD B3Main bars — correct spacing per drawing IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.3.3 (Minimum clear spacing between bars) ✓ Measure spacing between adjacent bars: minimum clear spacing = max of (bar diameter, 1.5× max aggregate size, 75mm); document min/max spacing; tolerance ±50mm OKNCNAHOLD B4Distribution bars placed correctly IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.3.2 — Distribution bars (Distribution bars perpendicular to main bars (in slabs); spacing typically 1/5 main bar spacing or 500mm max) ✓ Distribution bars perpendicular to main bars; spacing ≤max of (main bar spacing/5, 300mm, 0.3× lesser span); correct diameter per drawing OKNCNAHOLD B5Cover verified — bottom cover per IS 456 Cl. 26.4.2 IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.4.2 — Minimum cover (Mild: 15-20mm, Moderate: 25-30mm, Severe: 40-50mm (for bars, see Table 16)) ✓ Measure cover with cover meter or cover gauge at 5 locations; cover ≥specified minimum per exposure class (e.g., 30mm for M30 moderate); tolerance -5/+10mm OKNCNAHOLD C. TOP REINFORCEMENT C1Negative moment bars in correct position IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.5.2 — Top bars (cantilever/continuous spans) (Negative bars positioned to resist hogging moments at supports) ✓ Negative bars extend per drawing; typically extend from 0.2L each side of support; anchored with hooks/laps; spacing and diameter correct OKNCNAHOLD C2Cranking bars at correct location IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.3.2 — Bent-up bars (Bent-up bars locate at approximately L/7 from support (for cantilevers, at face of column)) ✓ Cranking location matches drawing ±100mm; cranked bars inclined ~45° per drawing; anchor beyond bend per Cl. 26.2.5.1 OKNCNAHOLD C3Chair bars/spacers support top bar mat IS 456:2000 Cl. 26 — Bar support practice (Top bars must be held in position during concrete placement) ✓ Chair bars or plastic spacers placed at ~1m grid spacing; height = design cover over top bars; chairs securely tied; no settling of top bars evident OKNCNAHOLD C4Cover to top bars verified per drawing IS 456:2000 Cl. 26.4.2 (Top cover typically same as bottom (e.g., 30mm) for slabs, varies for beams) ✓ Measure cover at 5 locations; cover ≥specified minimum (e.g., 30mm for M30 slab, 40mm for M30 beam bottom); use cover meter; tolerance -5/+10mm OKNCNAHOLD Showing 13 of 26 ·View all → Inspection Sign-Off APPROVED FOR CONCRETING — All checkpoints OK; ready for concrete pour APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS — Minor NCR raised; correctable defects noted; rebar inspection to resume after corrections REJECTED — Major non-conformances; concrete placement halted; rebar repositioning or replacement required Overall Verdict Name / Sign / Date Number of NC Items Name / Sign / Date NCR Number (if applicable) Name / Sign / Date Inspector Signature Name / Sign / Date Date & Time Name / Sign / Date Engineer Approval Signature Name / Sign / Date ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes -
